registered_before_results: written before any RULA/REBA score existed for any run and before the confirm and top-up analyses (kinematic and E) were run
basis: decision to make RULA/REBA a primary evaluation; frame-class design chosen to avoid conditioning on feasibility, which the arms themselves change

changes.what: new ergonomic family (ergo), one per method
changes.now: RULA/REBA interval scoring per config/ergo_rula_reba_20261105.json on every E run (delta 1.0 m). Primary outcome acceptable_lower: share of all trimmed frames that are feasible (residual <= 0.05 BW) and have a REBA lower bound <= 3

tests.R1: T_arm - C0 acceptable_lower != 0 (all methods; DART T_arm = G4)

changes.inference: as the registered E tests: equal-weight task means of paired (task, seed) differences at delta 1.0 m; 95% cluster bootstrap over tasks (10000 resamples, seed 20261104); exact sign-flip over task means, two-sided; Holm at 0.05 within each method's ergo family, separate from the H family; a test is supported when Holm p < 0.05 and the 95% interval excludes 0. Pairs enter only if both runs pass the E validity gates and the amendment-2 wrapper FK gate; all-pairs results reported as sensitivity
changes.stages: same task-seed cells as analyze_x3 --stage confirm and --stage top_up (DART seed 42 by the registered precision rule)
changes.insensitivity_rule: a method whose pooled C0 frames fall at least 90% in one frame class has its ergo tests reported as insensitive at this task class (walking) whatever the p values
secondary: Kimodo TO - T, OmniControl TS - T, DART W0 - G4 on acceptable_lower
the four frame-class shares per arm
the registered sensitivity analyses (conditional, ungated, neck from source geometry, RULA)
changes.why: kinematic and residual-force outcomes do not say whether a reachable motion is ergonomically acceptable; scoring only feasible frames would condition on a post-treatment variable

changes.now: E4 component contrasts and the ARDY M-series relative-offset correction arms scored with the same pipeline, reported descriptively; E4 levels across methods are task-confounded and are not a method ranking

unchanged: tasks, seeds, offsets, arms, H hypotheses, margins, inference of the H family, E criterion and its validity gates
